name: Otouto Freaks
source:
One day, my younger brother was chosen to become a hero!

He's going to defeat the demon king,
so let's go and gather some useful (not that I know what he could do with them) items!

[Translated from [url=http://cocoon.daa.jp/freaks/index.htm]official website[/url]]
